thread:
pagerbot: PAGER — Autoscaler fail: new GPU node provisioning repeatedly failing in asia-east1. Observed queue growth on hosted inference queues. Severity: P2. Affected: hosted-api generate endpoints, mainly p10/p11 model routes. Dashboard: https://observability.redwood/incident/6854321987 :rotating_light:

ashwin: acknowledging, joining. seeing steady queue growth ~420 -> 1.4k waiting in 10m across region. 99th latency up from 850ms -> 6s. rolling 503 spikes on short requests.

maria: on it. starting quick triage — checking cloud quotas and pending operations.

ashwin: paste of recent k8s events (trimmed):
```
Warning FailedCreate pod: failed to create node: quotaExceeded: Quota 'GPUS' exceeded for project
Status: 403
Operation: compute.instances.insert
```

maria: gcloud quota check shows GPUs used 96/96 for region asia-east1, project redwood-prod-1. No recent quota increase requests.

sre-oncall: immediate mitigation plan: (1) throttle low-priority routes (dev/test customers), (2) enable model-fallback to cpu-quantized small profile for non-latency-critical tenants, (3) drain and consolidate smaller jobs to free capacity. Who can flip throttles?

kevin: I can flip throttles. Which route names?

ashwin: route list: /generate/preview, /embed-batch-lowpri, /rerank-lite. We'll set limit=10rps for these.

kevin: applying rate-limit policy now via console. command: `infractl policy apply --route /generate/preview --rate 10`

deploy-bot: policy apply started by kevin.

deploy-bot: policy apply succeeded in 3 regions (including asia-east1).

maria: starting warmpool promotion and fallback: promoting spare warm VM pool for pt-quantized nodes. command: `infractl warmpool promote --region asia-east1 --count 4 --label temp-fallback`

eng-runtime-bot: warmpool promotion acknowledged. Provisioning 4 nodes (n1-standard + attached T4). Estimated ready ~4m.

ashwin: also enabling model fallback config: `redwoodctl models set-fallback --from model-p11 --to model-p11-quant-cpu --routes '/embed-batch-lowpri','/generate/preview'`

maria: fallback toggle succeeded. Traffic for low-priority routes now routed to quant-cpu variant. This should reduce GPU pressure by ~18% per our simulator.

sre-oncall: monitoring effects. Customer impact note: we've seen increased 5xxs primarily on best-effort tenants; premium tenants largely unaffected so far. Need to notify CS if high-value customers show degradation.

kevin: initial metrics after throttle+fallback (2m): queue length down 1.4k -> 810, 95th latency down 6s -> 2.2s, 5xx rate reduced from 3.9% -> 1.2%. Not fully recovered.

maria: warmpool nodes are up and joining cluster. `kubectl get nodes | grep temp-fallback` shows 4 new nodes ready. Autoscaler still reporting quota errors when trying to scale beyond these.

ashwin: good, but residual backlog remains. Next plan: apply short-lived per-tenant rate-sheds to cap concurrent requests for high-churn tenants. Also consider temporary cross-region failover for some traffic.

lina: I'm taking next oncall shift in 30m; request handoff once stable.

sre-oncall: copy. summarizing current state for handoff:
- root cause: region GPU quota at full utilization, autoscaler attempts blocked by quotaExceeded errors from cloud provider
- impact: hosted-api queues growing, mid-tier latency elevated, 5xxs concentrated on non-critical routes; premium routes mitigated by canary fallback
- mitigations executed: rate-limits applied to low-priority routes, model fallback enabled to cpu-quantized variants, promoted 4 warmpool nodes (T4) to reduce backlog, per-tenant rate-sheds planned
- status: queue partially reduced, 5xx down to 1.2%, but autoscaler still cannot request additional GPUs due to quota hard limit.

sre-oncall: action items for next oncall (lina):
1) continue monitoring dashboards and SLO alerting (latency, 5xx).
2) escalate quota request to GCP support if traffic won't drop; open case and track.
3) if quota increase denied or delayed, prepare cross-region routing plan (asia-northeast1 failover) — coordinate with network team.
4) coordinate customer comms for any tenants still impacted.

lina: ack, will take it. I'll open the GCP quota case now and add Ashwin + Maria as watchers.

ashwin: opened support case #INC-46271, priority P1 due to production impact. Link: https://console.cloud.google.com/support/cases/INC-46271

maria: quick note: we should also prepare a short-term config to reduce per-request batch sizes on GPU-heavy routes to squeeze more concurrency until quota resolved. I can land a small config patch `runtime: reduce_max_batch 32 -> 16` for a few routes.

kevin: agreed — smaller batches might increase latency but reduce blocking. I'll coordinate deploy.

deploy-bot: runtime config rollout started by kevin -> `runtime-config/v0.87.2` -> targeting asia-east1.

deploy-bot: runtime config rollout succeeded in asia-east1.

ashwin: metrics 8m after full mitigation set: queue 1.4k -> 360, 95th latency 6s -> 1.1s, 5xxs 3.9% -> 0.4%. Good improvement but keep watch for re-growth.

sre-oncall: customer impact summary for handoff / postmortem:
- window: ~6854321900 - 6854322020 (roughly 20m active mitigation)
- estimated affected requests: 7.2k requests with elevated latency / 5xx spikes
- worst impacted tenants: partner-A (non-prod), integrator-B (batch embed jobs), internal-load-tests (unexpected surge)
- revenue-impact: none identified for premium tenants; potential customer tickets from integrator-B (CS notified)

maria: leaving detailed log snippets in the incident doc: https://docs.redwood/incidents/6854321987/notes (will add exact timelines and commands).

lina: taking ownership for the handoff. I'll maintain the incident channel and post updates. Thanks all. :raised_hands:

ashwin: follow-up owners for postmortem: Ashwin (root cause + telemetry), Maria (mitigation engineering), Kevin (runtime config and throttles), Lina (incident ops + customer comms).

sre-oncall: closing active paging; monitoring mode ON. If any regressions occur ping @pagerduty immediately.

maria: one final admin — please file a quota request with org-sec to pre-authorize emergency burst increases for critical regions; was painful coordinate with billing mid-incident.

kevin: noted, will add to infra backlog.

pagerbot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigation succeeded, queue and error rates returned to near-normal. Handed over to oncall lina. Incident ticket: 6854321987.

lina: ack, will keep this thread updated with any customer escalations.

ashwin: thanks everyone. Postmortem to follow once we collect logs and GCP support response.
